title: #308 Not Enjoying
prompt: People should sometimes do things that they do not enjoy doing. Do you agree with that?

promptSegments.text: People should sometimes do things that they do not enjoy doing.

hardVocabulary.enGloss: A key word in this prompt.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first point is that doing things we dislike helps us learn new skills and become better at them.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first point is that doing things we dislike helps us learn new skills and become better at them.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second point is that doing things we do not enjoy helps us build good habits, which are important for a good life.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second point is that doing things we do not enjoy helps us build good habits, which are important for a good life.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Forcing oneself to do disliked activities can cause stress and make one feel tired and unhappy.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Forcing oneself to do disliked activities can cause stress and make one feel tired and unhappy.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Free time should be used for enjoyable hobbies, as this helps people relax and gain energy.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Free time should be used for enjoyable hobbies, as this helps people relax and gain energy.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Engaging in disliked activities teaches crucial life skills, such as time management and focus, which builds mental toughness.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Engaging in disliked activities teaches crucial life skills, such as time management and focus, which builds mental toughness.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Facing challenges outside one's comfort zone makes people more adaptable and builds confidence, as demonstrated by learning difficult skills like coding.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Facing challenges outside one's comfort zone makes people more adaptable and builds confidence, as demonstrated by learning difficult skills like coding.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Forcing oneself to do things one does not enjoy can be harmful to mental well-being.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Forcing oneself to do things one does not enjoy can be harmful to mental well-being.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Doing things we dislike can damage our overall sense of happiness.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Doing things we dislike can damage our overall sense of happiness.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not explain the statement without making your own position clear.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ giải thích nhận định mà quên nêu rõ quan điểm cá nhân.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.

modelPlan.focus: Explore the necessity and benefits of engaging in activities one does not enjoy for personal growth and practical life management.
keyArguments: Doing things we don't enjoy can lead to personal growth and discipline.
Engaging in such activities is often necessary for practical life management and achieving long-term goals.
